data.body: Update: remediation for Gerrit change 2928 has been amended and pushed as PS3 after a full local `make verify PYTEST_WORKERS=2` pass with GIT_CONFIG_* unset. PS3 tightens the internal Gerrit webhook path so tokenless acceptance requires the canonical Gerrit origin, no public forwarding headers, and the TCP peer resolving to the configured internal Gerrit service; it also fixes the auth-rejection metric reset behavior and updates the ADR/runbook/docs drift. Awaiting Gerrit LLM-Review and Verified votes before deploy/close.
